title: Understanding the Problem
text: The problem involves assigning probabilities to two sets of points and determining the correct ROC curve.

title: What is an ROC Curve?
text: An ROC curve is a graphical plot that illustrates the diagnostic ability of a binary classifier system as its discrimination threshold is varied.

title: Probability Assignment

title: Interpreting the ROC Curve
